title: Resting contact and 4-sphere columns (equal masses, and mass ratio 100 with the heavy one on top): penetration <= 1e-3 r, at rest, no energy gain, exact symmetry

tol.derivation: requirement: penetration <= 1e-3 r for every solver candidate; the mass ratio limit E_MASS_RATIO = 100 is where a 4-high column with the heavy body on top still meets it at dt 1/240 s, 32 substeps (mass splitting on the reference substrate: 6.8e-4 r; ratio 1000 reaches 1.2e-2 r): the limit was tightened, the requirement was not widened (design P2D10). At rest: 2 g h; energy: 16u per substep on the potential energy scale
